741440101.text: From the moment you asked that question, you became "dear friends."

741440102.text: Let's go tell Penny the good news.

741441801.text: Found it, found it, found it.

741441802.text: Those little troublemakers are competing again. Whoever catches them wins!

741441803.text: You mean, the swarms of fast-swimming blue fish are the "children" we need to bring back?

741441804.text: Yes! Yes! Catch up to them and tell them:

741441805.text: "I caught you! I caught you! I caught you!"

741441806.text: Looks like Mr. Cat Hatter was right. They really are a bunch of mischievous kids.

741440201.text: You have to use your head, not your ears, to truly get what others are saying.

741440301.text: "The little dog laughed to see such fun, and the dish ran away with the spoon."

741440303.text: Someone's singing here. Should we say hello?

741440310.text: Okay, alright, I got it. Greetings... friends from afar.

741440311.text: Welcome to... our party. Please take a seat.

741440312.text: Hmm, she looks very shy. Did we startle her?

741440315.text: Yeah, Paimon got you. We'll take a... Wait, Paimon's not seeing any seats!

741440318.text: Oh, it's okay, Nana, it's not necessary.

741440319.text: Mr. Quijano is right, we don't need to follow any awful rules. We just need cookies and bones.

741440321.text: Are you talking to the puppy?

741440322.text: No, not a puppy. This is... Lady Nana.

741440323.text: Anyway, that's it for the pre-meal speech. Time to raise a toast!

subQuests.subQuestName: Try to understand what Don Quijano and Nana are saying

741440402.text: #What are you saying? {M#He}{F#She}'s not stupid. Don't you talk bad about {NICKNAME}!

741440404.text: Yeah, it just came to Paimon without any effort.

741440406.text: What? Are you calling Paimon immature?

741440409.text: Woof, awoo, {RUBY#[D]It's because she listens from the heart.}woof-woof-woof.

741440408.text: Why, of course... Wait, no, Paimon was smart to begin with! Are you doubting Paimon's intelligence?

741442101.text: Penny, my dear, you shall have two new friends.

741442102.text: #The legendary adventurer duo, {NICKNAME} and Paimon, are willing to be our friends.

741442103.text: Really? Haha, awesome! I have so many friends now!

741442104.text: Let's have a ceremony to commemorate this.

741442105.text: The ceremony requires a speech. But alas! We lack the time to write a proper one.

741442106.text: Don't worry. Just keep it simple.

741442107.text: Very well, then I shall make this brief. Please, come forward.

741442109.text: Ladies and gentlemen, I hereby declare...

741442110.text: Penny, friend to the children, Don Quijano the Swashbuckler, and Lady Nana, hereby welcome Paimon and...

741442111.text: Ah, just a moment. How should I introduce you two?

741442112.text: You mean Paimon's title? You can call Paimon the Best Guide in Teyvat!

741442113.text: #And let's use Honorary Knight of the Knights of Favonius for {M#him}{F#her}, though {M#his}{F#her} other titles are awesome too.

741442114.text: No, no, no. That's not what Mr. Quijano is asking.

741442115.text: We need to know who your friends are.

741442116.text: Every one of us, cats and dogs, are bound together by the bonds of friendship.

741442117.text: A life bereft of friendship... Oh! Such a life would be too horrible. So, who are your friends?

741442119.text: Good. Penny always brings delicious food. And so, she is also a deity. The Goddess of Biscuits and Bones.

741442120.text: Then, my dear friends, from now on, you shall have one more deity friend.

741442127.text: Good. In the name of all the bearings, cakes, and storybooks—

741442128.text: #Penny, Paimon, and {NICKNAME} are now good friends.

741442129.text: You will share all your bones, biscuits, and picture books, and say "good night" to each other before you go to sleep.

741442130.text: Play in the mud together, scare birds together, and count stars together!

741442134.text: Now, we're all friends... But wait, the two of you haven't met the children yet.

741442135.text: Gosh! We almost forgot the children.

741442136.text: Strange. I haven't seen them all day.

741442137.text: The children are our friends, too. You two should meet them.

741442138.text: You're right. Please go meet the children. Let them know you are their new friends.

741442139.text: They probably went somewhere far away to play. It's high time they returned. Go into the water and have a look.

741442140.text: Don't worry, just go underwater. You needn't fret about the children not wanting to come back. I'll sing a song to send you along.

741442141.text: The children will come back to sleep in their big shells when they hear my song, so head over to the big shell and wish them sweet dreams.

741442122.text: Oh, deary me! Those are the only friends you have? It's okay. You have us now.

741442124.text: You are also Paimon's best friend!

741442125.text: Aha! So you are a pair of good friends. Wonderful!

741442126.text: I can see that Paimon is a truly great friend!

741442201.text: Bubble bubble, Penny is singing, bubble bubble.

741442202.text: So, the "children" Penny was talking about are fish!

741442203.text: #Hello, there. We're Penny's new friends, Paimon and {NICKNAME}.

741442204.text: Bubble bubble, new friends? New friends... New friends!

741442205.text: Bubble bubble! Sweet dreams, new friends!

741442206.text: Sweet dreams! Well, they seem happy. Now that we've met them, let's go to the next shell.

741442301.text: Bubble bubble, can't find. Bubble bubble, can't find!

741442302.text: #Hello, there. We're Penny's new friends, Paimon and {NICKNAME}.

741442303.text: Bubble bubble, new friends! Bubble bubble, old friends... can't find!

741442304.text: Bubble bubble... Penny is singing, bubble bubble... Sleepy...

741442305.text: They seem to have lost something. Strange... But we should be done here, so let's head over to the next shell first.

741442401.text: There's nothing here... Where are the "children"?

741442403.text: The "children" are gone, and there's only a Fatui insignia left inside the shell! We have to tell Penny about this!

741440601.text: Penny, we just met the "children" underwater.

741440602.text: How did it go? Did you become pals?

741440605.text: Penny, some of them went missing.

741440606.text: #We found this in their cradles. {NICKNAME}, if you would.

741440609.text: You probably don't know this, but the Fatui are a bunch of very, very bad guys. They might have kidnapped the "children."

741440610.text: But don't you worry, we'll help you, since we're friends now.

741440612.text: Are you saying that Kerek is a bad guy?

741440613.text: Huh? Kerek? Who or what is that?

741440614.text: Kerek oft sings with Penny. I once recommended he try his luck at the Opera Epiclese.

741440615.text: He does have a nice voice.

741440616.text: He would go underwater to play with the children as well.

741440617.text: That's right. Kerek is a swimmer most swift. I admire him greatly.

741440618.text: So, you mean there's a Fatuus named Kerek who is Penny's friend, and who left this mark behind?

741440619.text: I think so. This belongs to Kerek. He's our pal.

subQuests.subQuestName: Discuss the situation with Don Quijano
Discuss the situation with Don Quijano

741440801.text: Dear friends, how do you feel about the idea?

741440802.text: We just need to find the "children" and bring them back? Err, this probably isn't going to solve the real problem...

741440803.text: She still has to face growing pains, eventually.

741440804.text: I know, I know... But since she cannot choose... Can't we just let her grow up later?

741440805.text: Were Penny to grow up just like that, who would scratch under my chin? Who would cuddle me at night as I sleep?

741440806.text: No, no! Let us give her more time.

741440807.text: As Penny's dear friend, I must put a stop to her tears this very instant, and make her smile!

741440808.text: Lady Nana's purpose is to love Penny, and mine is to be Penny's knight! I must protect her from harm.

741440809.text: Alas! I truly am a failure. To think that Penny is crying before my very eyes! If only I were a real knight.

741440810.text: Out of curiosity, why do you want to be a knight so badly, Quijano?

741440811.text: It is my calling, friends. Have you never been entrusted with such a noble cause?

741440812.text: Rouge tasked me with this duty, and I took an oath to protect Penny.

741440813.text: Don Quijano is one who keeps his word! Now! There is no more time to lose. We must take action now!

741440814.text: Sure. Paimon doesn't want her friends to cry, either.

741440816.text: Very well. Then it's time to get up, Children!

741440817.text: Listen to me, Children! Our Penny is facing an unprecedented emotional crisis!

741440818.text: We must bring back all the missing troublemakers in order to restore her smile.

741440819.text: Then we shall sing together for her, and make her happy. That's what friends do, right?

741440821.text: #Honorable {NICKNAME}, Lady Paimon, this is embarrassing, but...

741440822.text: I, Don Quijano, am well-versed in both swords and fairy tales, and I am an ingenious gentleman. But I fear... I cannot swim.

741440823.text: May I task you with the glorious mission of retrieving the troublemakers from underwater?

741440824.text: Sure, it'll be a piece of cake.

741440826.text: Children, help our new friends out here, and don't be naughty.

741440827.text: Got it, got it, got it!

741440828.text: Follow us, follow us, follow us!

741440901.text: What song would you like to sing, Penny?

741441902.text: Good Nana, good girl. We can't keep crying.

741441601.text: We're back, everyone. Are all the "children" back as well?

741441602.text: #Yes. The Honorable {NICKNAME}, and Lady Paimon too, they have all returned.

741441603.text: We're here, we're here, we're here.

741441606.text: #I've stopped crying for a while now. Nana licked all of my tears away. Thank you, good Nana. You too, Quijano, {NICKNAME}, and Paimon.

741441607.text: My pleasure, Penny. It is my calling to love you, after all.

741441608.text: Ah-ha! I knew it, I knew our Penny would be strong enough, and would never keep crying.

741441609.text: Actually, I'm not that strong. I'm still a little scared and want to cry a little...

741441610.text: It's okay, don't be afraid! Let's sing!

741441611.text: Let's all swim and sing, Penny!

741441612.text: Great idea, my friends! Sadness and sorrow have been conquered, and so we shall raise our voices in glorious song!

741441613.text: Come here, new friends, board the wave's back, and she will carry you.

741441614.text: Don't worry, friends, we'll follow you on the shore.

741441702.text: That's a great song. I'm not scared now. It's fine to grow up! Nothing to it.

741441703.text: That was a great swim! No effort needed on our part... Though getting shot out of the water by "Bighead" at the end was plenty spooky.

741441706.text: Friends, seeing you all smile together makes me most happy indeed!

741441707.text: I've realized something big! I must tell Rouge about this the next time I see him.

741441708.text: I'm the shadow Rouge casts, and it is my honor to accompany you, my lady.

741441709.text: #Oh, and another thing, when Autumn comes back from the Court of Fontaine, I must tell her about you two, {NICKNAME}, Paimon!

741441710.text: Are you and this Autumn close, Penny?

741441711.text: Autumn's very nice to me. She left Nana behind to watch over me. They're my absolute favorites!

741441712.text: I am the fragrance that Autumn left behind, and your smile is my bliss, my dear Sweetheart.

741441714.text: Nana, did you hear that? Did something just go "thump"?

741441715.text: Yes, I heard it too. And did you notice? There is something shining in Penny's eyes.

741441717.text: It is the light of curiosity, which illuminates every dark corner, my dear.

741441718.text: And some glistening teardrops, making you all the more gentle.

741441719.text: You have already grown up with our blessing, my good child.

741441720.text: Wait, we haven't given Penny our blessings — and she's a grownup already?

741441721.text: #C'mon, {NICKNAME}, let's give Penny our blessings. May... uh, you always have a good appetite!

741441722.text: I'm a traveler, so... May you always have the courage to explore the world.

741441726.text: #I was going to become a grownup in the Court of Fontaine, but now I've changed my mind! I want to travel just like {NICKNAME}.

741441727.text: You mean you want to be an adventurer, Penny?

741441728.text: #Yes. {NICKNAME} and Paimon are adventurers. If I want to travel like them, I have to be an adventurer too.

741441729.text: If you want to be an adventurer, Penny, you have to get the Adventurers' Guild's approval first.

741441730.text: And that is a very hard thing to do, not to mention how the life of an adventurer's pretty tough, so are you sure that's what you want?

741441731.text: It's okay, I wanna give it a try!

741441732.text: In that case, I'll write a recommendation for you as your rite-of-passage gift, Penny.

741441733.text: You borrow pen and paper from Penny and write a simple introduction letter.

741441734.text: Wonderful, thank you! I love it! C'mon, I'll give everyone a gift too! Please gather 'round...

741441735.text: Penny skips and kisses Mr. Hat and Ms. Skirt on the forehead with a smile.

741441736.text: Then she kisses Paimon on the cheek before you bend over...

741441737.text: As Penny kisses your forehead with joy, you can almost feel her anticipation and unease about the future.

741441738.text: Dearest, most beloved friends of mine... I'm an adult now, and I'm going to be an adventurer!

741449902.text: "The cat and the fiddle, the fish jumped over the moon."

741449904.text: That sure is a unique friend, who loves talking to themselves so much. But Paimon doesn't mind.

741449905.text: Let's go to that big shell Penny mentioned and look for the "children."

741449906.text: Rock a bye, baby, on seaweed-top.

741449909.text: If the stem breaks, the cradle will fall.

741449910.text: Yet I will catch you, cradle and all.

741449911.text: Baby is drowsing, cosy and fair,

741449912.text: I sing a lullaby, oh baby hear:

741449917.text: Don't lose it, lose it, lose it.

741449918.text: Ahead, ahead, ahead, you'll find the troublemakers ahead.

741449919.text: These kids don't feel all that reliable... But well, they are kids. We shouldn't pin too many hopes on them...

741449920.text: Let's have a closer look around and see what happens, shall we?

741449930.text: Stuck and so worried, so worried we are.

741449931.text: Get her out, get her out!

741449932.text: This one is certainly much larger. She must be the one.

741449933.text: Free at last, free at last! I can sing along with everyone again!

741449934.text: Sing together, and together we sing!

741449952.text: Don't be scared, don't be scared! Penny's waiting for you to go back home.

741449953.text: Penny, looking for us? Home, home, let's go home quick!

741449954.text: Let's go home, new friends, let's all go home. Penny's waiting for us there.

741449955.text: Alright! Let's go look for Penny. Mr. Hat and Ms. Skirt are probably waiting for us, too.

741449969.text: Swim on, fly on, swim, swim, fly!

741449970.text: Stuck in rocks, stuck in rocks, stuck in the rocks.

741449971.text: So worried, so worried, worried are we.

741449972.text: It seems like the troublemakers are trapped among the rocks. Let's try to break the rocks and rescue them.
